explanation: The statement concerns the library's own objects: the carrier group scheme `points A` of the short-root type-G2 construction over ZMod 3, the library-defined `specialIsogeny` monoid hom, and the library-defined `weightTorusPoints`. Searching Mathlib (and Batteries/Lean core) for `g2SpecialIsogeny`, `weightTorusPoints`, `G2ShortRoot`, `specialIsogeny`, and for the surrounding constants in the algebraic-group/Lie directories turned up no declaration mentioning these notions; Mathlib has no theory of this special isogeny or of these torus point maps, so there is no duplicate or single-declaration special case.
